user.title: STP Token Updater
user.description: Enter the direct local API address of the token provider. Do not use an ingress URL.

credential.title: Provider credentials
credential.description: The credential is stored only in the Home Assistant config entry and is never exposed by STP entities or diagnostics.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate STP
reauth_confirm.description: The provider rejected the stored credential. Select the authentication method to use for reauthentication.

error.cannot_connect: The token provider cannot be reached.
error.unsupported_provider: The provider response is not supported.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This provider URL is already configured.

init.title: STP Token Updater options
init.description: Dry-run prevents every sponsor-token write. Disable it only for a deliberate live update.

authentication.title: STP authentication failed
authentication.description: The provider rejected the stored credential. Open the integration and complete reauthentication.

trial_source.title: Trial-token source unavailable
trial_source.description: STP could not fetch or parse the official trial-token source. No token is written while the source is unresolved.

renewal_warning.title: Token expires soon
renewal_warning.description: Less than the configured warning threshold remains without a verified replacement.

renewal_critical.title: Token expiry is critical
renewal_critical.description: Less than one hour remains without a verified replacement.

token_expired.title: Token expired
token_expired.description: The active token has expired. STP keeps the problem visible and retries on the controlled post-expiry schedule.

yaml_conflict.title: Token is controlled by a file configuration
yaml_conflict.description: The provider reports a file/YAML-managed sponsor token. STP cannot verify an API-written token as authoritative while this source remains active.

rate_limit.title: Provider or source rate limit active
rate_limit.description: STP received a rate-limit response. Automatic network activity is deferred according to Retry-After when available; no blind retry loop is used.
